_comment: The role vocabulary this product must agree on. The server is authoritative: apps/api/src/middleware/rbac.ts PERMISSIONS decides what a role may do, and apps/api/src/modules/admin/routes.ts VALID_ROLES decides which values can be assigned. Both are asserted against this list by apps/api/tests/role-contract.test.ts; the web app asserts that every role here has a user-facing label (apps/web/src/lib/labels.roles.test.ts). A role added on one side without the other fails a test instead of rendering as a raw enum string.

legacy_labels.QC_OFFICER: Labelled in the UI but not issuable by the server today (no PERMISSIONS entry, absent from VALID_ROLES). Kept as a label so a historical row that carries it still renders as words rather than as QCOFFICER; the tests assert labels for the roles above, and tolerate this one.
